topic: Olympia, Greece, 776 BCE: the first recorded Olympic Games, where the main race was a sprint of about 192 metres.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: Olympia’s Big Sprint!

shots.narration: A sparkle storm! Where has Zoya landed?
shots.scene: Ancient Olympia, Greece, beside a sunlit earthen running track; vertical 9:16, cinematic 3D animation, no visible writing.
shots.action: Zoya materializes beside Tock inside a swirling cloud of golden sparkles and dust.
shots.mood: Brilliant blue watch glow, warm sunlight, welcoming adventure.

shots.scene: An open earthen track bordered by grassy banks and distant green hills, bright ancient Greek landscape, no visible writing.
shots.action: Zoya turns toward the long running track.
shots.mood: Golden sunshine, vivid greenery, wide-eyed discovery.

shots.narration: [excited] These are the first recorded Olympic Games!
shots.scene: Trackside in ancient Olympia, with packed earth, grassy slopes and distant trees, vertical cinematic composition.
shots.action: Tock presents the track with an outstretched brass arm.
shots.mood: Proud little guide, gleaming brass, cheerful historical wonder.

shots.narration: The main race was a sprint of about 192 metres.
shots.scene: A long view down Olympia's straight earthen running track beneath a clear blue sky, no markings or writing.
shots.action: Zoya shades her eyes while looking toward the far end.
shots.mood: Sunlit scale, warm dust, impressed curiosity.

shots.narration: Zoya wants a little practice run beside the track.
shots.scene: A level strip of bare earth beside the empty running track, with Tock standing safely to one side.
shots.action: Zoya leans into a playful running pose.
shots.mood: Eager grin, bright yellow hoodie, friendly anticipation.

shots.scene: Close ground-level view of Zoya's shoes on the trackside path, one loose shoelace clearly visible.
shots.action: Tock points at Zoya's untied shoelace.
shots.mood: Gentle comic surprise, sparkling brass, harmless little obstacle.

shots.narration: A quick knot makes her ready.
shots.scene: The sunny earthen path beside Olympia's track, framed closely around Zoya's hands and shoes.
shots.action: Zoya ties her loose shoelace into a bow.
shots.mood: Calm concentration, warm sunlight, reassuring simplicity.

shots.scene: The clear practice path beside the ancient track, with Tock stationary on the grassy edge.
shots.mood: Bouncing ponytail, tiny dust puffs, joyful movement.

shots.narration: [giggles] Tock makes an excellent cheering section.
shots.scene: The grassy edge of Olympia's track, with sunlit packed earth behind Tock.
shots.action: Tock bounces on his tiny legs.
shots.mood: Delighted glass face, shiny brass, playful spring tail.

shots.narration: Zoya finishes her practice with a giant smile.
shots.scene: A clear patch of trackside earth near Tock, with the long ancient running track stretching behind them.
shots.action: Zoya slows to a smiling stop beside Tock.
shots.mood: Rosy cheeks, happy accomplishment, soft golden dust.

shots.narration: One ancient sprint, one enormous adventure!
shots.scene: Olympia's sunlit trackside, grassy banks and green hills behind the companions, no visible writing.
shots.action: Zoya raises her glowing blue wristwatch.
shots.mood: Growing blue light, floating golden sparkles, satisfied excitement.

shots.scene: The same Olympia trackside setting, framed vertically around the companions and Zoya's luminous watch.
shots.action: Tock tilts his round glass face toward Zoya.
shots.mood: Curious expression, blue reflections, golden sparkles promising another adventur

episode.endHook: The blue watch glows again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle into Olympia, Greece, in 776 BCE, the year of the first recorded Olympic Games. They discover a sprint of about 192 metres—and Zoya finds a tiny obstacle to her own practice run!
